🌐 Google Chrome Shortcut Keys in Hindi

Browser mein roz ka kaam – tab kholna, band karna, history saaf karna – yeh sab keyboard se aur tez hota hai. Yeh shortcuts Microsoft Edge mein bhi chalte hain.

Is page par 32 shortcuts hain. Search box mein likh kar dhoondo aur Copy dabao.

Chrome Keyboard Shortcuts

ShortcutKya hota haiCopy
Ctrl + TNaya tab kholo
Ctrl + Shift + TGalti se band hua tab wapas kholo
Ctrl + WAbhi wala tab band karo
Ctrl + NNayi window kholo
Ctrl + Shift + NIncognito window kholo
Ctrl + TabAgle tab par jao
Ctrl + Shift + TabPichle tab par jao
Ctrl + 1 to 8Us number wale tab par jao
Ctrl + 9Aakhri tab par jao
Ctrl + LAddress bar select karo
Ctrl + EnterAddress bar mein www. aur .com khud lagao
Ctrl + DPage ko Bookmark karo
Ctrl + Shift + BBookmarks bar dikhao/chhupao
Ctrl + HHistory kholo
Ctrl + JDownloads kholo
Ctrl + Shift + DeleteBrowsing data / history saaf karo
Ctrl + FPage mein shabd dhoondo
Ctrl + RPage reload karo
Ctrl + Shift + RCache ke bina reload karo (Hard reload)
Ctrl + +Zoom in karo
Ctrl + -Zoom out karo
Ctrl + 0Zoom normal karo
F11Full screen karo
Ctrl + PPrint karo / page ko PDF save karo
Ctrl + SPage save karo
Ctrl + UPage ka source code dekho
F12Developer Tools kholo
Alt + ←Pichle page par jao (Back)
Alt + →Agle page par jao (Forward)
SpacePage neeche scroll karo
Shift + SpacePage upar scroll karo
EscPage loading rok do
